top_catalog_fingerprints: SELECT t.table_name, '?' AS table_type, COALESCE(c.comments, '?') AS table_comment FROM all_tables t LEFT JOIN all_tab_comments c ON c.owner = t.owner AND c.tab
SELECT c.table_name, c.column_name, c.data_type, CASE WHEN c.nullable = '?' THEN '?' ELSE '?' END AS is_nullable, c.column_id AS ordinal_position, c.data_defaul
SELECT con.table_name, cc.constraint_name, cc.column_name, cc.position AS ordinal_position FROM all_constraints con JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON con.constraint_n
SELECT con.table_name, con.constraint_name, cc.column_name, rcon.owner AS ref_owner, rcon.table_name AS ref_table, rcc.column_name AS ref_column, con.delete_rul
SELECT i.table_name, i.index_name, ic.column_name, COALESCE(ic.descend, '?') AS order_direction, i.uniqueness, ic.column_position AS ordinal_position FROM all_i
SELECT v.view_name, v.text, c.comments FROM all_views v LEFT JOIN all_tab_comments c ON c.owner = v.owner AND c.table_name = v.view_name AND c.table_type = '?'
SELECT table_name, column_name FROM all_tab_columns WHERE owner = :owner ORDER BY table_name, column_id
SELECT object_name, object_type, procedure_name FROM all_procedures WHERE owner = :owner AND object_type IN ('?', '?', '?') ORDER BY object_name, subprogram_id
